from pathlib import Path
from kernel import run

def test_training_fixture():
    Path('training.csv').write_text("Lab Spectrometer,Export 2\nWavelength,Signal\nnm,linear a.u.\n1549.8,0.17\n1549.9,0.67\n1550.0,1.17\n1550.1,0.67\n1550.2,0.17\n")
    result = run('training.csv')
    assert result['center_nm'] == 1550.0
    assert abs(result['fwhm_nm'] - 0.2) < 1e-9
